name: lactation overview
title: Breastfeeding trouble sorted by which of the three needs broke: low supply split by the latch into inadequate production or poor extraction, nipple or breast pain (mastitis pointed to the breast chart), and stopping, either because breastfeeding is contraindicated or because she chooses to wean; each column gives what to look for and how to manage it, with panels on the first week and on contraception while breastfeeding

root.title: Breastfeeding trouble: which of the THREE needs broke?
lines: prolactin MAKES milk · oxytocin EJECTS it · the infant or a pump must REMOVE it, starting by day 3
from day 3, milk removal (not hormones) drives supply

groups.title: LOW SUPPLY
lines: the commonest reason to stop breastfeeding

pres.title: 1 · Confirm low intake, then watch a feed: is the LATCH good?

head: h
Inadequate production
milk is not MADE
clue: • little breast growth in pregnancy, breast surgery or radiation
• polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), prolactinoma, insulin resistance
tx: • fails to thrive or loses weight

head: h
Poor extraction
milk is not GOT OUT, so less is made
clue: • preterm, in neonatal intensive care, separated from her
• cleft lip or palate, sucking or swallowing problem
tx: 1 · Fix the latch, feed on infant cues
hand-express every 2–3 h, keep it to supplement later

head: h
Nipple or breast pain
clue: • engorgement, blocked ducts, too much milk

head: h
Do NOT breastfeed
or she declines
clue: • cancer drugs: see the DRUGS chart
Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV): avoid in developed countries
World Health Organization: OK if both on antiretroviral therapy

head: h
Weaning
timing is her decision
clue: • rapid fall in prolactin may worsen depressive symptoms

panels.title: The first week
items: start within 1 hour, skin to skin · feed on infant cues
colostrum alone for 2–4 days: antibodies, cells, vitamins A, D, E, K
stored milk, laws of 6: room 6 h · fridge 6 days · freezer 6 months

panels.title: While breastfeeding
items: contraception: NO estrogen (↓ milk quality and quantity) · safe: hormonal or copper intrauterine device (IUD), progestin-only pill, barrier, depot medroxyprogesterone
more fluids, calories, calcium and vitamins
medicines, alcohol, smoking: see the DRUGS IN PREGNANCY AND LACTATION chart
